name: Rest & Recovery
content:
RESTING DURING A QUEST

During the Quest phase of play, party members may take one Short Rest and one Long Rest per day. The Quests' Keeping may alter the effects of resting (see the Treasure, Keeping & Equipment section), but these are the default effects:

SHORT REST

At least 1 hour of undisturbed rest is considered a SHORT REST. If you are not Helpless, you recover Endurance equal to your BODY score.

LONG REST

At least 6 consecutive hours of undisturbed rest is considered a LONG REST. You recover all of your Endurance. If you’re Helpless, you instead recover Endurance equal to your BODY score. If you have 0 Hope, you regain 1 Hope.

If a Long Rest is interrupted by one hour or more of activity or any amount of combat, you instead gain the benefits of a Short Rest.

INTERMEZZO

An Intermezzo (the time between Quests - see the Phases of Play section) is another opportunity to rest and recover from the hardships of the questing life. In addition to the broad narrative possibilities of an Intermezzo, there are some specific actions characters may choose to take to restore their strength:

DISTRIBUTE REMAINING COMPAGNIA

Any Compagnia (see the Per-Quest Mechanics section) left over at the end of the previous Quest may be distributed among those who participated in the Quest. Each point distributed in this way removes 1 Shadow or clears 1 Condition for the recipient. Players should reach consensus about how to distribute the points.

TREAT INJURIES

For each day spent in the care of a skilled healer, remove 1 Injury. Depending on the circumstances, the GM may require that you maintain a certain keeping or spend an amount of Treasure to account for the healer’s wages (see the Treasure, Keeping & Equipment section).

STRENGTHEN COMPAGNIA

If you and another member of the party spend most or all of the Intermezzo in one another's company, you each clear 1 Shadow or clear one condition, and the party starts the next Quest with one additional Compagnia (if one of you is included in the Quest). Describe how you spend your time together and how it strengthens your bond.

CLEAR CONDITIONS

The narrative requirements for clearing Conditions during an Intermezzo are the same as during a Quest, but in some situations it may be wise to deal with those emotions in a more controlled environment than during a Quest. See the Conditions section.
